title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion more, taking family charity gifts past $29 billion
summary_full: Warren Buffett has ramped up his charitable efforts, revealing a staggering donation of Berkshire Hathaway shares valued at $5.47 billion. This sizable contribution focuses primarily on four family-operated charities, with a significant portion directed to the Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation. With an earlier donation nearing $6 billion, his total charitable giving surpasses $11.4 billion in 2026.
